title: #2894 C (analytic): a refused line reads the configurations its own search walked — half the work, the same words

cases.title: An isosceles triangle with a right base angle is refused quickly, with today's words
cases.lookFor: On a cleared canvas, type the three lines. The third is refused about twice as fast as before (measured: half the solver work), with today's message word for word: «∠ABC = 90» flattens ABC — together with the earlier givens it forces the vertices onto one line, and a flat shape is not a triangle as «משולש ABC» says; «∠ABC = 90» is not added. Two rows stay.
cases.before: The same refusal, word for word, after about twice the work (750 958 → 385 932 units).
